Hi team / Eleanor —

Thanks again for the commitment — quick handoff note from sales into CS so we can get the implementation started next week. TL;DR: 11/22 targeted pilot start, Private deployment (VPC) requested, SOC2 evidence and network allowlist required before staging, SSO via SAML 2.0.

Deal context (short):
- Annual commitment: $420k (commercially executed).
- Pilot: 2-week pilot to validate inference latency in customer's VPC with 50 agents and ~300 concurrent users expected for peak.
- Billing & legal: SOW signed pending DocuSign (attached v1). Procurement expects PO; Ben will own that loop.

Open technical/security asks for CS to validate during kickoff:
- SOC2 Type II report (customer security team will need this).
- Network allowlist + egress rules (see attached network_requirements.xlsx).
- KMS integration: customer uses AWS KMS (CMK in us-west-2).
- Data retention: 30-day ephemeral logs; confirm ability to turn off logs on private deployment.
- SSO: SAML metadata pending from Medivance.

Proposed owners / asks
- Primary CS owner: please nominate (Olga/Tessa suggested).
- Technical lead: Marcus (prelim).
- Sales contact (me) will manage procurement and billing questions.

Kickoff: propose Fri 11/12 10:00 PT for a 60-minute kickoff (technical + ops).

Attachments: SOW_Medivance_v1.pdf (stub), network_requirements.xlsx (stub), kickoff-recording-demo.mp4 (link stub).

Next steps for recipients:
- Olga / Tessa: confirm owners and whether you want a pre-kickoff internal sync.
- Marcus: flag any blockers for VPC install (rough VM/instance sizing, required ports).
- Eleanor / Jose: confirm kickoff time and SAML metadata cadence.

Thanks —
Ben

- SAML: need metadata + expected user attribute mapping (email, groups).
- KMS: AWS CMK ARN + whether Medivance needs BYOK (bring-your-own-key) or managed key.
- Network: ingress/egress, proxy rules, CIDR blocks — I'll validate against the attached implementation-checklist.xlsx.
- Acceptance criteria for pilot: latency SLO (p95 < 600ms), data retention toggles, and success demo checklist.

Questions for sales: 
1) Concurrency expectation — Ben listed ~300 concurrent; is that steady-state or peak?
2) Who will own the PO and procurement deadlines (we need lead time to schedule staging windows)?

I also recommend a 30-minute deep-dive with Marcus and our infra before Fri 11/12 to review the network spreadsheet and KMS flow — Thu 11/11 09:00 PT works for me.
